preserved_verdicts.P7_6B_claim_boundary: prospectively replicated under the evaluated synthetic protocol

older_generic_p7.role: development/calibration vocabulary and previously frozen generic lifecycle machinery
older_generic_p7.reason: older chronology; calibration-only center guard and primary ratio 5 convention

p7_2_proposed.role: historical Proposed behavior/calibration lineage and frozen data-generation path
p7_2_proposed.reason: later explicit GateCal-v2/ActionCal-v2 selection and freeze

p7_6b.role: frozen A1 representation evidence and immutable recoverability-inference artifact authority
p7_6b.reason: later representation replication; immutable artifact now used only by the prospective P7.7 zero-boundary RI-admission rule

p7_6b_outcome.reason: establishes representation evidence but does not by itself establish lifecycle superiority or authorize final-heldout access

common_behavior.gate_estimator: immutable P7.6B A1 estimator on causal same-identity history
common_behavior.A1_artifact_role: frozen operational recoverability evidence for RI admission; never forces RI
common_behavior.p7_2_delta_R_role: historical lineage only; never reused as an A1 threshold

lifecycle_state.fixed_identity_maintenance: adapt current m_t for exactly 50 updates on D_upd; evaluate on D_assess; retain identity
lifecycle_state.model_level_RI: only a selected frozen-bank identity changes m_t
lifecycle_state.maintenance_opportunity: each stage after D_upd and D_assess are available and before D_srv is sealed
identity_reset: construct new identity S_m from last 200 D_assess raw observations with 104 exact errors
hold S_m fixed for the new identity lifetime

recoverability.online_evidence: immutable P7.6B A1 prediction from same-identity causal response history normalized by identity-held S_m
recoverability.oracle_recoverability: offline diagnostic only; never an online feature or action input

ri_admission.rule: negative operational recoverability evidence makes RI admissible; it never forces RI
ri_admission.candidate_source: existing frozen eleven-identity bank plus bound P3.2 source-bank identities
ri_admission.candidate_adaptation: exactly 50 frozen updates per feasible candidate using existing seed+center+stage*1000+500+bank_index rule
ri_admission.feasibility: unchanged frozen deployment parameter and operation limits for the center budget tier
ri_admission.evaluation: same D_assess, same loss, same candidate budget and bank filter
ri_admission.comparison: pre_loss vs local_loss+0.1*unit vs candidate_loss+10*0.1*unit; exact tie order retain > local > bank order
ri_admission.acceptance: commit only the minimum feasible action under the frozen comparison
ri_admission.fallback: if no acceptable candidate exists, retain or accept fixed-identity local maintenance according to the same comparison; never force identity change

a1_reset.S_m: max(median(exactly 104 pointwise squared errors from the frozen 200-observation deployment reference),1e-12)
a1_reset.ri_reference: last 200 raw observations of current D_assess after candidate adaptation and before identity commit
a1_reset.history: same-identity causal response history; reset after RI
a1_reset.reason: P7.7A-2 Branch B uses the already frozen A1 zero-boundary evidence only to open RI admission; it does not force RI or alter candidate search, costs, feasibility, adaptation or fallback

comparators.semantics: P7.7 Recoverability-Guided Lifecycle; P7.2 delta retained as historical lineage

counterfactual_paths.common_randomness: only exogenous generator and fixed per-operation seeds before method-specific state divergence
counterfactual_paths.method_specific_state: parent model, identity, response history, S_m, evidence and subsequent service path after action divergence
counterfactual_paths.paired_analysis: paired center-level analysis with method-specific causal trajectories

endpoints.primary: mean lifecycle service loss = mean over center, seed, scenario of stage-mean service MSE
endpoints.cost_semantics: service performance and action costs are reported separately; ratio 10 remains the historical behavior-path parameter, not a new primary objective weight
endpoints.oracle_labels: offline only after sealed decisions; never online

statistical_plan.aggregation: stage then seed/scenario within center, then arithmetic mean across centers
statistical_plan.paired_rule: paired center-level Proposed-versus-baseline comparisons where valid
statistical_plan.interval: percentile 95% interval using NumPy linear quantiles
